3. It then asserts that the name of the entry is "sample/link-to-txt-file.lnk".
4. It asserts that the last modified date of the entry is the epoch date (January 1, 1970).
5. It also checks if the entry is a symbolic link using `isSymbolicLink()` method.

The failure occurs at step 59 where the assertion for the last modified date fails because the actual last modified date retrieved from the `TarArchiveEntry` is different from the epoch date.
